[[cha:g-codes]]
= G-Codes

== Conventions

In the G-code prototypes the hyphen (-) stands for a real value and (<>) denotes an optional item.
// a line comment that must disappear

[[gcode:g4]]
== G4 Dwell(((G4 Dwell)))

[source,ngc]
----
G4 P-
----

* 'P' - seconds to dwell (floating point)

////
This comment block must be removed from the text.
////

The P number is the time in seconds that all axes will remain unmoving.
See also <<gcode:g1,G1>> for feed moves.

.G4 Example Line
[source,ngc]
----
G4 P0.5 (wait for 0.5 seconds before proceeding)
----

[[gcode:g10-l2]]
== G10 L2 Set Coordinate System(((G10 L2 Coordinate System)))

[width="75%",options="header"]
|===
|Code |Meaning
|G10 L2 P1 |Set the G54 origin
|===

image::images/g10.png[]

G10 L2 offsets the origin of the coordinate system specified by P.
